answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 1677 Country: India Title: My question is can I kiss the hand of Ameer Jamat or any other syed Maualana or any highly respected sufi only for respect.? Question: My question is can I kiss the hand of Ameer Jamat or any other syed Maualana or any highly respected sufi only for respect.? Answer ID: 1677 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 969/969=J) One should not kiss the hand of any aalim, ameer jamat or buzurg out of respect. Yes, if anyone kisses it out of extreme love it may be allowable; this will not be termed as unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
